name: cloudcostwise
description: Find AWS waste, including kinds AWS's tools miss. Local, read-only. Nothing sent unless you opt in.

settings.name: AWS profile
settings.description: The AWS profile to scan with (read-only access is enough). Leave empty to use the default profile. Credentials set only as environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and similar) are not passed to extensions; file and SSO profiles work.
